description: This file defines the VariationCache class in the Drupal core cache system, implementing cache context support with redirect chain management, cache ID generation, and cache operations such as get, set, delete, and invalidate.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Cache\VariationCache
classes.description: Implements cache variation handling with redirect chains and cache context support in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new VariationCache object with dependencies on RequestStack, CacheBackendInterface, and CacheContextsManager.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item based on keys and initial cacheability, following redirect chains.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache items, following redirect chains and optimizing cache lookups.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores cache data with associated keys and cacheability, managing redirect chains and cache contexts.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes cache entries based on keys and cacheability, following redirect chains.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates cache entries based on keys and cacheability, following redirect chains.

methods.name: getRedirectChain
methods.description: Retrieves the full redirect chain for given keys and cacheability, following redirects until a cache miss or final cache object.

methods.name: getValidatedCachedRedirectChain
methods.description: Validates and retrieves a cached redirect chain, ensuring it is still valid based on cache contexts.

methods.name: maxAgeToExpire
methods.description: Converts a max-age value to an expiration timestamp for cache storage.

methods.name: createCacheId
methods.description: Creates a cache ID based on keys and cacheable metadata, considering cache contexts.

methods.name: createCacheIdFast
methods.description: Creates a cache ID based on keys and cacheability, optimized for speed without cache context effects.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal redirect chain cache, used mainly for testing.
